Privacy Statement (for Customers) (PDF 355KB) (Effective July 2026)
I. Privacy Statement
This Privacy Statement sets out how PCCW Limited (“

PCCW
”) and its subsidiaries, affiliates and associated companies

Data
”) (the PDPO and other applicable data protection laws such as where applicable the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) (the “

GDPR
”), collectively, the “
Data Protection Laws
”) that we may collect from or about you. It applies to all individuals whose Data may be handled, whether as data user (as defined in the PDPO or where applicable, other similar terminology to that effect under the Data Protection Laws) or data processor (as defined in the PDPO or where applicable, other similar terminology to that effect under the Data Protection Laws), by the PCCW Group.

In the event a Group Entity has its privacy statement or applicable addendum to this Privacy Statement tailored to the relevant jurisdiction it operates (collectively, the “
Entity Privacy Statement
”), please also refer to the relevant Entity Privacy Statement on how it uses your Data. In case there is any conflict between the Entity Privacy Statement and this Privacy Statement, the Entity Privacy Statement shall prevail.
II. Protecting your privacy
This Privacy Statement (a) reflects our commitment to Data protection and to handle and process your Data in a transparent and secure manner, and (b) sets out how your Data is being handled, your rights and how you can contact us, under the applicable Data Protection Laws.
Before collecting and processing your Data for the purposes as set out in this Privacy Statement, we may be required by the applicable Data Protection Laws to obtain your written consent (directly or indirectly), and in such cases, only with such written consent (directly or indirectly), may we use your Data in the manner as specified hereunder.
III. Collection of Your Data
Failure to provide Data and/or Special Categories of Data (as the case may be) that is indicated as mandatory will prevent us from providing those particular Services to you.

2.
How We Use Cookies and/or Tracking Tools
Some of our websites and/or mobile applications use cookies or similar tracking tools on your computer, mobile phones or devices for us to, for example, personalise your user experience and/or maintain your identity across multiple webpages and/or Internet sessions (the “
Tracking Data
”). The Tracking Data may include, but is not limited to, relevant login and authentication details as well as information about your activities and the preferences configurations on your device and across our websites and mobile and TV applications.
For details on how we use cookies, please refer to our Cookies Policy.

Direct marketing (if applicable)
We may, in compliance with applicable Data Protection Laws, and, where applicable, with your consent use your Data (including without limitation name, contact information, phone number, residential/office address and email address and information about the Services you have purchased but except health and biometric information), for us and the HKT Group and respective dealers, suppliers, licensors, providers and/or business partners of both PCCW Group and HKT Group (collectively, “
Service Providers
”)) to provide you with direct marketing content (pursuant to which we may or may not receive remuneration in return), including sending to you notices and/or updates about gifts, discounts, privileged offers, benefits and promotions related to Services offered by us and/or the Service Providers, including without limitation: TV, telecommunications, over-the-top (OTT) services, content services, mobile voice, SMS and data communications, IDD/roaming, Internet connectivity, cloud services, electronic/ mobile payment, entertainment, secretarial services, personal assistant services and information services (such as weather, finance and news information), device accessories, mobile applications and software, computer peripheral, accessories and software (including notebooks, handsets, mobile devices and accessories, keyboards, security installations and mobile applications), reward, loyalty and privilege programmes, lifestyle, networking events, travelling, banking, alcohol and tobacco, sports, music, gaming, transportation, household products, food and beverages, finance, stored value facilities, electronic wallets, cryptocurrencies, digital assets and related offerings and services, insurance, wealth and asset management services and products, pensions, investments, brokering, financial advisory, credit and other financial services and products, betting, education, health and wellness, beauty products and services, fashion and accessories, electronics, social networking, technology, e-commerce, logistics, retail, home and décor, media, high-end consumer products and services, shopping malls and outlets, property developments, public services, utility services, donations and contributions for charitable and/or non-profit making purposes.
We may carry out direct marketing through a variety of ways (such as in the form of a letter, bill insert/message, email, digital SMS, MMS, instant message, app push notification, targeted TV message, broadcast message on eye device, by telephone, social media or advertisements on websites or other means).
Before using and providing your Data for the purposes as set out in this Privacy Statement, where we are required by the Data Protection Laws to obtain your written consent, and in such cases, only after having obtained such written consent, may we use and provide your Data for any promotional or marketing purpose.
We will honour your request to not using your Data for the purposes of direct marketing and/or provide your Data to third parties (whether to the Organisations and/or the Service Providers) for their direct marketing purposes. You may opt-out, free of charge, from receiving direct marketing material and/or communications from the relevant Service, loyalty programme and/or My HKT, or you may request that we cease to provide your Data to third parties, which we will cease to do so. At the same time, you may resume receiving the same (if you have previously opted-out of receiving such material and/or communications from the relevant Service, loyalty programme and/or My HKT) by making a written request to our Group Data Protection Officer together with your registered name and service account number, registered telephone number or login name (as applicable).
V.

Export of Data
At times it may be necessary and/or prudent for us to transfer your Data to other jurisdictions outside of Hong Kong or the country in which you receive our Service(s) (“
your Country
”), for instance, for the prevention, detection or investigation of crime or for storage, processing and other purposes for which the Data were collected. In the event that we do transfer your Data outside of Hong Kong or your Country, appropriate safeguards will be put in place in compliance with the prevailing requirements of the applicable Data Protection Laws.
VI. Safety of Your Data
All required efforts are made to ensure that any Data held by us is stored in a secure and safe place and is accessible only by our authorised employees or other Organisations.
When we pass your Data to third party Organisations for them to process, we seek to ensure that they have appropriate security measures in place to keep your Data safe and to comply with this Privacy Statement and the applicable Data Protection Laws. Some of the parties we share your Data with may process it overseas. You can contact us for more information about the safeguards we use to ensure that your Data is adequately protected in these circumstances.
VII. Retention of Your Data
We will retain your Data in accordance with our internal policies. Your Data will only be retained for as long as we need it for the purposes as stated in this Privacy Statement (and directly related purposes) unless the Data is also retained to satisfy any applicable statutory, regulatory or contractual obligations or for the purpose of investigation, detection and prosecution of crime. Once your Data is determined to get erased, your Data will be securely purged from our electronic, manual and other filing systems based on the above criteria and our internal procedures. Our internal policies are committed to be in compliance with the applicable Data Protection Laws.
VIII. Third Party Websites and/or Mobile and TV Applications
Our websites (including but not limited to www.pccw.com, www.pccwsolutions.com, www.viu.com, www.viu.tv, http://media.netvigator.com, www.moov.hk, www.moovshop.com, www.makerville.hk, www.makealive.com, www.mirrorweare.com) and mobile and TV applications (if any) may contain links to other websites, webpages and mobile and TV applications operated by third parties (collectively, the “
Third Party Sites
”). You should be fully aware that the provisions of such Third Party Sites do not constitute an endorsement, approval, or any form of association by or with us. We have no control over the content of the Third Party Sites or the way in which the operators of those Third Party Sites deal with your Data, and we are not responsible for the content of such Third Party Sites. You should review the privacy policy of such Third Party Sites to understand the ways in which your Data may be used by those third parties.
IX. Your Rights
We are committed to safeguarding your Data and ensuring that you may exercise your rights. You have the following rights:
a. To request access to your Data that we hold. Where permitted under the relevant Data Protection Laws, we may apply an administrative charge for providing you with access to your Data in response to such request;
b. To request correction to your Data that we hold;
c. To request us to stop using your Data for direct marketing; and
d. To make a complaint to a data protection authority about how we are using your Data.
If you wish to access or amend any of your Data we hold, or request that we delete (only applicable where the rights to erasure is required by law) any of your information that is no longer necessary for the provision of our Services, you may contact us in the manner as set forth under the “How to contact us” section.

If you are a user of My HKT, you may exercise your right of access and correction by logging on to your My HKT account where you will be able to view and correct the Data held by us and/or any relevant/applicable members of the HKT Group about you. If you are not a user of My HKT, you may write to our Group Data Protection Officer at the details stated in the “How to contact us” section below.
You may decline to share Data with us and/or withdraw any consents which you may have provided, in which case, we may not be able to provide you with some of our Services.
At any time, you may object to us holding or processing your Data, on legitimate grounds, save and except as otherwise permitted by the applicable Data Protection Laws.
X. How to contact us
For all issues and enquiries regarding our obligations and compliance under the applicable Data Protection Laws, and any request for access to, correction or deletion of your Data, please contact us in writing:
Group Data Protection Officer
PCCW Limited or the name of the appropriate Group Entity that collects your Data
Mailing address: GPO Box 9872, Hong Kong
or email :
[email protected]
To raise an issue regarding our handling of your Data, please contact us for our attempt to resolve your issue.
XI.
Changes to this Privacy Statement
This Privacy Statement may be amended from time to time and all handling of Data will be governed by the most recent version of this Privacy Statement, available on our website at
http://www.pccw.com/legal/privacy.html
.
XII.
Inconsistency or Conflict
If there is any inconsistency between the English and Chinese (or other local) versions of the Privacy Statement, the English version will prevail.
XIII. Miscellaneous
Nothing in this Privacy Statement shall limit your rights under the applicable Data Protection Laws.
This Privacy Statement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of Hong Kong.
Verison Date : 10 July 2026
